reader.decision: Approve `cache: pnpm` on `actions/setup-node@v4` as the primary change. Keep the explicit `actions/cache` version as the fallback if eviction of the `main` entry shows up. Before merging, confirm that `pnpm-lock.yaml` exists in the real repository.
reader.decision_reason: It is a one-line change with a measured saving of about 3 min per run, and the message names a clear trigger for switching to the alternative. The main risks (eviction, lockfile presence) are small or checkable.

reconstruction.problem: Every `ci` run in `fernway-web` restores no cache and downloads the full 1.1 GB pnpm store in `Install`, a median of 3 min 40 s. The median run is 11 min 05 s, and all 412 runs of week 43 repeated the download.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Nothing is broken. Developers wait longer than needed before merging, and about 21 runner-hours (about 10 USD) per week go to the repeated download.
reconstruction.fix: Add `cache: pnpm` under `with` on `actions/setup-node@v4` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. `pnpm/action-setup@v4` already runs before it. The key comes from the lockfile hash. The expected median is about 8 min 00 s, a saving of about 28%. The alternative is `actions/cache` with an explicit key from `hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml')`.
reconstruction.cost: The change itself is one line. The first run after each lockfile change is a miss and still takes 3 min 40 s, plus a save step. The 1.1 GB store against a 10 GB limit could allow eviction of the `main` entry, though compression probably makes the entry smaller (unverified). The 35 s figure excludes restore time, so the real saving is slightly lower. `setup-node` fails if `pnpm-lock.yaml` is missing, which was not checked. The explicit `actions/cache` version costs about ten more lines to maintain.

follow_up_questions: Does `pnpm-lock.yaml` exist at the root of the real `fernway-web` repository? `setup-node` fails without it.
reader.closing_answer: I approve `cache: pnpm` on `setup-node`. I want the lockfile checked before merge, and I will switch to the explicit `actions/cache` version if `main` cache eviction shows up.
